title: Kagamine Len — We Would Know〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Maybe she has lunch practice again...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I think it's a good thing that she's so hungry. It's a sign that she's happy and motivated!>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. I wonder what she'll be having for lunch.>

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
What...? Minori, you're back already?
That was so fast!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I want to spend as much time as possible with everyone during lunch today!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Sure. While we're at it, should we invite a few others?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hey, wanna have lunch with us?

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line:
Mind waiting for one more?
She's grabbing something to eat now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Are you two about to have lunch?!
Wanna join us?

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Really? Then, we'll bring our lunches over now!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Shiho, Kohane!
You two should join us too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Sure... Wait, hold on...
How many people did you invite...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Everyone who was still in the classroom!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay, we have two more joining us!
Please try to make some room for them if you can!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Is there room on your side?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Hinomori! Azusawa!
You two can sit here!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: This is incredible! Our desks are all together like lunchtime during elementary school!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...!
I couldn't put my finger on it, but I knew this felt nostalgic somehow!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Alright, I think we all have a seat.
Minori, let's start eating!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, everyone! Put your hands together and...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Yeah, and they're all really into it!
They brought their desks together and were even nice enough to make room for more people♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, your fruit sandwiches look really good!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Here, have a bite.
In return, Hanasato, I get to try your bread.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Hehe. They look like they're having so much fun♪>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <People really seem to gravitate toward Minori...>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <She's very open with her feelings, so I can see why others would have no trouble reciprocating.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Friends really are a wonderful thing to have.>
